name: Sales
description: Discovery questioning, consultative pitch, objection handling, and executive closing.

dimensions.name: Discovery Questioning
dimensions.description: Uncovering budget, decision-making authority, pain intensity, and timeline.

rubricCriteria.90-100: Deep open-ended questions; diagnoses before prescribing; prospect does 70% of talking.
rubricCriteria.70-89: Good diagnostic flow with minor premature pitching.
rubricCriteria.50-69: Interrogative or superficial; misses core business driver.
rubricCriteria.0-49: Immediately pitches product without understanding prospect's situation.

dimensions.name: Objection Rebuttal
dimensions.description: Reframing price, competitor, and timing objections with empathy and economic proof.

rubricCriteria.90-100: Validates concern, isolates real objection, reframes around ROI and risk.
rubricCriteria.70-89: Answers objection directly but misses deeper underlying hesitation.
rubricCriteria.50-69: Becomes argumentative or offers discounts too early.
rubricCriteria.0-49: Accepts objection passively or capitulates on price.

dimensions.name: Closing & Next Steps
dimensions.description: Securing clear next steps, dates, and commitments without being pushy or passive.

rubricCriteria.90-100: Clear reciprocal agreement; locks calendar date and agenda for mutual action plan.
rubricCriteria.70-89: Agrees to next meeting but leaves exact date or deliverables open.
rubricCriteria.50-69: Passive 'Let me know if you have questions' sign-off.
rubricCriteria.0-49: No call-to-action; allows call to fizzle into dead silence.
